title: Drug KEEPER™ Storage Cabinets for Hazardous Chemical and Drug Evidence Storage
meta_title: Drug KEEPER™ Hazardous Chemical and Drug Evidence Storage Cabinets
meta_description: Ductless, self-contained Drug KEEPER™ storage cabinets provide safe, compliant storage for confiscated hazardous chemicals and illegal drugs. Protect users with advanced filtration.
meta_keywords: drug storage cabinet, hazardous chemical storage, evidence storage, ductless cabinet, filtered storage
short_description: Drug KEEPER™ storage cabinets can be used for short-term storage of hazardous chemicals and substances typically associated with drug investigations.
full_description: The ductless Drugkeeper storage cabinet is self-contained and does not require venting to the outside. Many units are portable and may be moved with minimal downtime and without filter changes. Set-up, operation and filter maintenance are straightforward. Because filtered air is returned to the room, no demands are required of the facility HVAC capacity for make-up air.
seo_content: Drugkeeper special purpose storage cabinets offer an economical solution for safe storage of confiscated hazardous chemicals and illegal drugs. Cabinet airflow and face velocity protect users from incidental exposures while electronic airflow monitoring assures continuous safety. Activated carbon main filters are formulated for general purpose storage; optional HEPA filters eliminate exposure to biological particulates. Air Science ductless technology combined with innovative filtration technology creates a safe work environment over a wide range of applications.

Compliance & Certifications.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood.

features_data: Returned filtered air eliminates HVAC demands
Activated carbon main filters for general storage
Optional HEPA filters for biological particulates
Electronic airflow monitoring for continuous safety
Protects users from incidental chemical exposures
applications: Short-term storage of confiscated hazardous chemicals
Storage of illegal drug evidence and related substances
Use in state and federal crime labs, medical examiners, and forensics
Deployment in law enforcement agencies, hospital emergency rooms, and drug agencies
